The same rule as the Marr-Hildreth detector, here on its LoG with sigma 1.5. The LoG, shown with the offset mapping, is above 128 on the dark side and below it on the bright side. The first pixel below 128, next to one above, is marked with 255. It is the first bright pixel of the step.
